body:
The beauty of the Actors Access profile is that if you set it up just right, it can be the only link needed to market your actor.

Actors Access is the performer gateway to Breakdown Services. Breakdown is home to a vast majority of all TV, Film & Broadway castings. Agents and Managers use the site predominately when submitting Actors for projects. It is the number one most important profile to maintain as an actor. Make it look good.

Free Headshot Guide

Check It Out

Tip: Only keep current, quality headshots in profile. Get rid of anything that does not currently look like the actor. If you love the old headshot, then right click and save but please remove the outdated pics.

Custom Demo Clip Scripts

Written for each specific actor and their strengths. Coaching and other add-ons available.

Tip: Upload at the very least, two examples of acting skill. A comedic and dramatic scene or monologue will do in a pinch. Stay away from uploading commercials with no dialogue by actor. And never upload recorded stage performances.

Easy To Read & Invaluable

Over 100 pieces of advice specific to child actors and the TV/Film industry.

Tip: Format your resume to Industry standards. This means a three column format. With Film, TV, Theatre & Training sections. Most impressive credits first.


I’ve got a lot more to say and show! Sign up for the Child Actor 101 Zoom event that is being held on 3/15/2022 @ 530pm pacific. It is an interactive and informative meeting. Open to only 20 participants. A LIVE review of your child’s profile is an option and is useful to all in attendance.
